functions.description: Partially update Adobe-stored metadata for an organization-managed Enterprise or Federated user. Personal Adobe IDs cannot be edited.

domain.description: Required directory domain for a non-email federated login; omitted for email login.

dryRun.description: Limited validation only, without saving metadata.

email.description: New email address; case-only changes are not supported and domain changes require the provider's directory policy.

username.description: New federated username where supported; not a generic Adobe-ID login edit.

changes.description: Partial metadata changes; omitted properties are unchanged; null and empty values are rejected, so clearing is not offered.

userLogin.description: Current exact email-based or non-email federated login to modify.

FunctionInput_adobe_umapi_updateuser.description: Current managed identity and the metadata fields to partially update.

recovery.description: Caller next step appropriate to this code.

severity.description: Whether this is an error or warning.

items.description: One provider error or warning and its recovery guidance.

issues.description: All provider errors and warnings with recovery guidance.

status.description: Provider action outcome: success, partial, or error.

FunctionOutput_adobe_umapi_updateuser.description: Adobe action outcome, command counts, and provider issues.

orgId.description: Adobe organization ID for this connection, configured by the connection administrator.

tags.instructions: Find the current login/domain with `get-user` or `list-users`. Use `create-user` for new identities. Omitted fields are unchanged; this tool does not clear fields or update country. Email changes may also change the username and require claimed domains in the same directory. Use the old login to target a rename.

functions.name: update-user-group
functions.description: Partially update a user group's name or description without changing its membership lists.

description.description: New description; empty string requests clearing it.

changes.description: Partial changes; omit properties to preserve them. Null is rejected.

groupName.description: Exact current user-group name, not its ID.

FunctionInput_adobe_umapi_updateusergrou.description: Target an existing user group by its current name and supply partial metadata changes.

recovery.description: Caller next step for this issue.

items.description: An Adobe error or warning with recovery guidance.

FunctionOutput_adobe_umapi_updateusergro.description: Adobe action status, actual and test-mode command counts, and provider issues.

orgId.description: Adobe organization ID configured by an administrator for this connection.

tags.instructions: Get the exact current group name from `list-user-groups` or `list-groups`. Use the old name to target a rename. Omitted changes are unchanged; description may be emptied. Read-only shared groups cannot be modified. Use membership tools for users and product-profile access.
